title: Equivariant critical point theory and bifurcation of $3d$ gravity-capillary Stokes waves
summary: We establish novel existence results of $3d$ gravity-capillary periodic traveling waves. In particular we prove the bifurcation of multiple, geometrically distinct truly $3d$ Stokes waves having the same momentum of any non-resonant $2d$ Stokes wave. This unexpected clustering phenomenon of Stokes waves, observed in physical fluids, is a fundamental consequence of the Hamiltonian nature of the water waves equations, their symmetry groups, and novel topological arguments.
